entitlement.keyring_unavailable: I-Dawnlist ayikwazanga ukuvula indawo yokugcina imininingwane yokungena yale khompyutha (i-Credential Manager ku-Windows, i-Keychain ku-Mac), lapho ikhiye lakho lelayisensi ligcinwa khona, futhi le khophi ayikaqinisekiswa muva nje. Vula noma qala kabusha indawo yokugcina imininingwane yokungena bese uzama futhi — akukho okukhanselwe.
entitlement.licence_inactive: Leli khiye lelayisensi liyiqiniso kodwa alisasebenzi — ukubhalisela kuphelile, kukhanselwe noma kubuyiselwe imali. Vuselela ukubhalisela, bese uqhuba futhi; uma ukholelwa ukuthi kufanele kube kusasebenza, bhalela ku-Apps@spencerfields.com. Ibhodi lakho nomsebenzi wakho ohloselwe kuhlala kuvuliwe noma kunjani.
entitlement.mac_lapsed: I-App Store ithi ukubhalisela kwakho kwe-Dawnlist akusasebenzi — kungenzeka kuphelile, kukhanselwe noma kubuyiselwe imali. Kuvuselele ku-App Store, bese ucindezela u-Buyisela umthengo ku-Amasethingi. Ibhodi lakho, umsebenzi wakho ohloselwe nakho konke okuvele kukule Mac kuhlala kuvuliwe.
entitlement.mac_not_subscribed: Akukho kubhalisela kwe-App Store okuqinisekisiwe kule Mac okwamanje, ngakho ayikho i-feed yemisebenzi yokufunda. Bhalisela ku-Amasethingi, noma ucindezele u-Buyisela umthengo lapho uma usuvele wabhalisela. Ibhodi lakho, umsebenzi wakho ohloselwe nakho konke okuvele kukule Mac kuhlala kuvuliwe.
entitlement.mac_unreachable: Akukwazekanga ukufinyelela isevisi yokubhalisela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubhalisela kwakho kwe-App Store, futhi akukaqinisekiswa muva nje. Hlola uxhumo lwakho bese uzama futhi — akukho okukhanselwe.
entitlement.ms_lapsed: Ukubhalisela kwakho i-Microsoft Store kuphelile. Bhalisela kabusha ku-app ukuze uqhubeke.
entitlement.ms_not_subscribed: I-Dawnlist idinga ukubhaliswa. Ungaqala ukubhalisa ku-app.
entitlement.ms_unreachable: I-Microsoft Store ayifinyeleleki, ngakho ukubhaliswa kwakho akukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. I-Dawnlist izozama futhi.

Yifake kabusha lapho uyithole khona. Ibhodi yakho nesifingqo sakho kusala kuvuliwe kunoma yiziphi izimo.

families.body: Uma unqaba izindima ezimbili ezifanayo kumqashi oyedwa, i-Dawnlist inikeza umthetho: vimba lowo msebenzi kulowo mqashi, kodwa uqhubeke ufunde abanye. Akukho okusebenzayo uze uvume, futhi isiphakamiso ngasinye sikhombisa ukunqatshelwa okwakhelwe kukho.

onboarding.aim_placeholder: Umusho owodwa noma emibili, ngamazwi akho. Ufuna umsebenzi onjani, izinga elingakanani, kuphi, ukuqashwa okuhlala njalo noma kwesikhathi esithile, kanye nomholo ophansi ongawamukela ukuxoxa ngawo. Noma yini oyishiyayo, i-Dawnlist kuzodingeka iyiqagele.

onboarding.blocker_decide: Nquma okungenani okungu-{needed} kwezikhangiso ezingu-{total} ({decided} kuze kube manje)
onboarding.blocker_sentence: {title} e-{company}: awuvumelananga, ngakho chaza ukuthi yimuphi umusho, ongengezwa ku-brief, obuzokwenza lokhu kube yikho okulungile — ukulungiswa okungenawo umusho ngeke kusinde
onboarding.blocker_short_sample: I-Dawnlist ayikwazanga ukulanda izikhangiso eziphilayo ezanele ukuze zilinganiswe nazo — {count} kwezingu-{needed} eziyidingayo. Lokhu kuyinkinga yokusetha, hhayi okuthile okwenzile: qinisekisa ukuthi ukusesha kuvuliwe nokuthi i-feed iyafinyeleleka, bese uzama futhi.
onboarding.calibration_body: Nazi izinto eziyishumi zomsebenzi eziphilayo, kanye nokuthi i-Dawnlist icabange ukuthini ngayinye. Lungisa noma yini eyenze iphutha. Lapho ungavumelani, tshela ukuthi yimuphi umusho obungazoyilungisa – lowo musho uyongena esifingqweni sakho, ukuze iphutha elifanayo lingaphindwa ekuhambeni okulandelayo.
onboarding.calibration_failed: I-Dawnlist ayikwazanga ukulanda izikhangiso zokulinganisa: {reason} Ungaqhubeka uqedele ukusetha; ukulinganiswa kuzokwenzeka ekuseni lapho ikwazi ukufunda i-feed.
onboarding.calibration_fetching: Ilanda izikhangiso eziphilayo bese izifunda ngokuhambisana ne-brief yakho. Lokhu kuthatha umzuzu noma kanjalo.
onboarding.calibration_no_feed: I-Dawnlist ayikabi na-feed yemisebenzi engayifunda, ngoba alikho ukubhalisela noma ikhodi yokufinyelela kule khompyutha. Ungaqhubeka uqedele ukusetha; ukulinganiswa kuzokwenzeka uma usunayo.
onboarding.calibration_pending: I-Dawnlist ayikalinganiswa okwamanje, ngakho lezi zinqumo zisekelwe ku-brief yakho kuphela futhi azikaze zihlolwe ngokuhambisana nokwahlulela kwakho. Ukulinganisa kuthatha imizuzu embalwa: I-Dawnlist ikubonisa izikhangiso eziyishumi eziphilayo, uwulungise lapho iphambanise khona, bese i-brief yakho ifunda ngokusuka emahlukaneni.
onboarding.calibration_skipped: Bekungekho izinto eziphilayo zomsebenzi ezanele ukulinganisa nazo, ngakho lesi sinyathelo sidluliwe – akukho lutho owenzile. I-Dawnlist iyokunikeza leli sinyathelo futhi ngenkathi ulivula kabusha, uma usuku selusukelwe futhi ukudla kufinyeleleka. Ungaqhubeka nokuqedela ukusetha.
onboarding.close_unsaved: I-Dawnlist isasebenza kokuthile, futhi lokho engakaqedi kuzolahleka. Vala ukusetha noma kunjalo?
onboarding.corpus_earliest_year: Indima yokuqala etholakele iqala ngo-{year}. Uma wawusebenza ngaphambi kwalokho, kwengeze — izindima zokuqala zokusebenza yizona ezitshela isihlungi ukuthi yimiphi imisebenzi oyenza ngempela.
onboarding.corpus_none: Awukho umbhalo we-CV ofundekayo otholiwe — qinisekisa ukuthi amafayela avuleke kahle ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
onboarding.corpus_one_version: Kufundwe uhlobo lwe-CV olulodwa kuphela. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zichaza indima efanayo ngamagama ahlukene, futhi lezo zinhlobonhlobo ziyibufakazi — engeza ezindala uma usenazo.
onboarding.discard_sample: Usuvule ukusesha okuhlukene selokhu lezi zikhangiso zalandwa. Ukulanda isethi entsha kubiza imali ngasinye sesikhangiso esikubuyisela, futhi izinqumo ozenzile lapha zizolahleka.
onboarding.docx_unpacks_too_big: le .docx ivula ibe idatha eyeqe kakhulu kunalokho okudingwa noma yiliphi idokhumenti, ngakho ayivulwanga
onboarding.draft_failed: Akukwazekanga ukubhala uhlaka kusuka kuma-CV akho: {reason}. Ungayibhala yomibili imibhalo wena ngokwakho bese uqhubeka.
onboarding.draft_no_cvs: Engeza ama-CV akho kuqala — buyela esinyathelweni sokuqala uwafake, noma uwakhethe khona.
onboarding.drafted: Kubhaliwe uhlaka. Lungisa noma yini engalungile ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
onboarding.drop_hint: Faka amafayela e-CV lapha — i-PDF, i-Word noma umbhalo ongumhlaba
onboarding.file_too_large: ifayela lingu-{size} MB futhi umkhawulo ungu-{limit} MB — awukho i-CV enkulu kanjalo, ngakho alivulwanga
onboarding.ingest_guidance:
Hudula zonke izinhlobo ze-CV yakho osenazo — kuhlanganisa ezindala, ezenzelwe umsebenzi othile, kanye nalezo ocabanga ukuthi ziphelelwe yisikhathi.

Ungaziqoqi kuqala. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zichaza indima efanayo ngamagama ahlukene, futhi lezo zinhlukwano ziyibufakazi. I-CV eyodwa ekhazinyuliwe iyinto encane kunazo zonke ongayinikeza kulesi sinyathelo.

Uma i-CV yakho iqala phakathi nendlela yomsebenzi wakho, kusho lokho. Izindima zokuqala zivamise ukususwa ku-CV yesikhulu, futhi isihlungi siyazidinga: yizona ezisitshela ukuthi yimiphi imisebenzi yokusebenza oyenza ngempela, hhayi kuphela leyo osuyiphathile.
onboarding.interview_body: I-Dawnlist ifunde ama-CV akho futhi yabhala amadokhumenti amabili. Wawalungise – ayisiqalo, hhayi isinqumo. Iphepha lamaqiniso ngakwesobunxele yiyona nto kuphela okuvumelekile ukuthi umsebenzi wakho wokuphumela obala ukuthi ukhulume ngawe. Isifingqo ngakwesokudla sinquma ukuthi yini eshicilelwa kwiuhambo lwansuku zonke.
onboarding.low_signal: Uvumelane nakho konke, okuvamise ukusho ukuthi lesi sampula besilula kunokuthi ibhrifi isiphelele.
onboarding.no_brief_yet: Ayikabi khona i-brief yokulingana, ngakho akukho lutho ukulinganiswa okungakulungisa. Buyela emuva ubhale womabili amadokhumenti, noma uwabhale ngokwakho, bese uqeda.
onboarding.open_questions: I-Dawnlist ayikwazanga ukuthola, futhi ishiye lezi zivuliwe:

onboarding.ready: Kulungile — ibhrifi yakho izobuyekezwa ngalokho okuyifundisile.
onboarding.searches_body: Lokhu kuphakanyiswe ngokususela kulokho othe ukufuna kwakho. Ziqala zicishiwe, ngoba yileyo naleyo ithatha imali ngokusekelene nesikhangiso ngasinye esibuyiswayo — ngakho vula lezo eziyizinsesho zangempela, ushiye lezinye. Ungazishintsha noma nini ku-Settings.
onboarding.searches_none: Azikho izinsesho eziphakanyiswe. Ungakwazi ukuzengeza ku-Settings uma usuqedile ukusetha.
onboarding.searches_nowhere: I-Dawnlist ayikwazanga ukuthola ukuthi ufuna umsebenzi ube kuphi, ngakho lokhu akukwazi ukuvuliwa okwamanje. Usesho olungenandawo lubheka emhlabeni wonke, futhi zonke izethulo elizibuyisayo ziyakhokhelwa. Buyela emuva ushise ukuthi kuphi empendulweni yakho, noma ukusethe Kuzilungiselelo uma usuqedile ukusetha.
onboarding.searches_off: Akukho lutho olusetshenziswayo, ngakho uhambo lwansuku zonke luyoba thulile. Ungaqhubeka bese ulusebenzisa kamuva ku-Settings.
onboarding.searches_where: Yonke insesho ibheka ku-{where}. Ungakushintsha lokho Kuzilungiselelo.
onboarding.sentence_placeholder: Yimuphi umsho, ongezelela kwibhrifi yakho, owawuzokwenza lokhu kube kahle?
onboarding.terms_body: I-Dawnlist ikubonisa izikhangiso zemisebenzi eziqhamuka kumhlinzeki wedatha, futhi izimo zihlanganisa ukuthi yini ongayenza ngazo. Zifushane. I-Dawnlist ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa ngaphandle kokuzivumela, ngakho sicela uzifunde ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
onboarding.terms_changed: Izimo sezishintshile selokhu wazivumela ngokugcina, ngakho sicela uziphinde uzifunde futhi.
onboarding.title: Dawnlist — ukulungiselela
rules.body: Ngaphambi kokuba noma yini ifundwe imodeli, i-Dawnlist ihlola ngokumelene nala magama. Isaziso esiqedwa lapha asibizi lutho; isaziso eliphumelelayo libiza ingxenye encane yesenti ukuze lifundwe. Qala ungenalo neze — engeza igama uma ubona uzenza sona isinqumo kabili.
rules.conflict: Akwengeziwe — lokhu bekuzobe kufihle isikhundla owasifunayo:
rules.contextual_help: Amagama asho okuthile esihlokweni somsebenzi kodwa angasho lutho endimeni yezinzuzo. Aqhathaniswa nesihloko nenkampani kuphela.
rules.employers_help: Kutholakala, akubhalwa. Ukufuna isikhundla kwengeza umqashi wakhe lapha, futhi zonke izaziso ezilandelayo ezivela kubo ziyafundwa. Shintsha isinqumo futhi kuyaphuma futhi.
rules.heading: Imithetho yokuhlola
rules.strong_help: Uphawu noma kuphi — esihlokweni, enkampanini noma encazelweni. Isaziso esifanele okukodwa kwalokhu sihlala sithunyelwa ukuze sihlolwe.
rules.unsupported_help: Amagama esihloko akhipha isaziso noma umqashi angakanani ukuba muhle. Ahlolwa kuqala, futhi amelene nawo wonke amasu owake wawafuna ngaphambi kokuba avunyelwe.

searches.body: Lezi yizinto ezisheshwa ohambweni lwansuku zonke lwe-Dawnlist, olwenzeka ngesikhathi sohambo esisethwe ngezansi kwesi sikrini, ngenkathi i-Dawnlist isebenza. Usesho olusebenzayo lubiza imali nsuku zonke lusebenza, ngoba ukudla komsebenzi kukhokhisa ngokwesishicilelwe esibuyisiwe – ngakho lezo eziphakanyiswe yi-Dawnlist ngokusekelwe kulokho okuyisho ziqala zivaliwe kuze kube yilapho uzifundile.

settings.admin_body: Khipha amakhodi okwedlula amalungelo, futhi uwahoxise. Ikhodi inikeza ukufinyelela; ayithengisi lutho. Sho ukuthi ikhodi ngayinye ithintela bani — ikhodi engenagama ayikwazi ukubalulwa kamuva. Ikhodi ehloselwe umhloli wohlelo kufanele ivumele ukusetshenziswa okuningi: umhloli angahle ahlole kumishini eyedlula eyodwa, noma aphinde ahlole ngemva kokwenqatshwa, futhi ikhodi esisetshenzisiwe iyakuphenduka kokho kube ukuhlolwa okuhlulekile.
settings.admin_confirm_revoke: Hoxisa u-{code}? Uyayeka ukusebenza ngokushesha, kanjalo nazo zonke ilayisensi esezikhishwe kulo. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
settings.admin_expires_tip: Zingaki izinsuku ikhodi eliqhubeka lisebenza. Ikhodi yomqondisi ngokwakhe kuphela, noma leyo esohlelweni lomnikazi, engabekwa ukuthi ayiphelelwa isikhathi.
settings.admin_issued: Kukhishwe {code}. Yikopishe manje; iboniswa kanye kuphela lapha.
settings.admin_no_licence: Alikho ilayisensi kule mishini, ngakho akukho okumele kulawulwe.
settings.admin_uses_tip: Ingaki izikhathi le khodi engasetshenziswa ngazo. Ungalokothi ukhethe u-1 kumhloli.
settings.code_store_failed: Ikhodi lamukelwe, kodwa i-Dawnlist ayikwazanga ukugcina ilayisensi elikunikeze lona ngoba indawo yokugcina imininingwane yokungena yale khompyutha ayiphendulanga. Ikhiye lakho lelayisensi ngu-{key} — likopishe manje bese uligcina, ngoba ikhodi lingase lingasebenzi okwesibili.
settings.data_body: Izikhangiso zemisebenzi ku-Dawnlist zinikwe ilayisensi ngumhlinzeki wedatha wangaphandle. Ungazisebenzisela ukufuna umsebenzi wakho, kuhlanganise nokugcina lezo ozibeke ohlwini lwakho oluqokiwe. Awuvumelekile ukusakaza kabusha noma ukuthengisa kabusha lezi zikhangiso, noma ukuzisebenzisela ukwakha isevisi yemisebenzi encintisana neDawnlist. Le mikhawulo iyaqhubeka isebenza ezikhangisweni ozigcinile ngemva kokuphela kokubhalisa kwakho.
settings.key_body: I-Dawnlist ifunda izimemo zemisebenzi futhi ibhale imiyalezo yakho isebenzisa amamodeli e-Anthropic, kwi-akhawunti yakho siqu. Dala ukhiye ku-console.anthropic.com bese uwunamathisela lapha. Ungawuhoxisa noma nini, futhi i-Dawnlist iwugcina kusiphathi samagama emvume yesistimu yakho yokusebenza — akulona ifayela.
settings.key_forgotten: Ukhiye ususiwe. I-Dawnlist ayikwazi ukusebenza uze wengeze okunye.
settings.key_none: Akukho khiye ogciniwe okwamanje — i-Dawnlist ayikwazi ukusebenza ngaphandle kwawo.
settings.key_store_failed: I-Anthropic yamukele ikhiye, kodwa i-Dawnlist ayikwazanga ukulisindisa ngoba indawo yokugcina imininingwane yokungena yale khompyutha (i-Credential Manager ku-Windows, i-Keychain ku-Mac) ayiphendulanga. Akukho okusindisiwe. Hlola indawo yokugcina imininingwane yokungena, bese ucindezela u-Sindisa uphinde uhlole.
settings.licence_body: Namathisela ukhiye welayisensi ovela kwi-imeyili yakho yokuthenga. Uma unikwe ikhodi yokungenisa esikhundleni salokho, namathisela leyo — i-Dawnlist izoyishintshanisa ngelayisensi.
settings.licence_inactive: Le layisensi ayisasebenzi — ukubhalisela kuphelile, kukhanselwe noma kubuyiselwe imali. Kuvuselele futhi i-Dawnlist izosebenza futhi.
settings.licence_store_failed: I-Dawnlist ayikwazanga ukugcina ikhiye lelayisensi ngoba indawo yokugcina imininingwane yokungena yale khompyutha (i-Credential Manager ku-Windows, i-Keychain ku-Mac) ayiphendulanga. Akukho okusindisiwe — hlola indawo yokugcina imininingwane yokungena, bese ucindezela u-Sindisa futhi.
settings.licence_unknown: Isevisi yelayisensi ayilazi leli khiye. Lihlole nge-imeyili yakho yokuthenga.
settings.licence_unverified: Kusindisiwe, akukaqinisekiswa — isevisi yelayisensi ayikwazanga ukufinyelelwa. I-Dawnlist izophinde ihlole ngaphambi kokuqhutshwa okulandelayo.
settings.offer_assigned: {code} — nikeza lokhu ku-{who}. Kopisha manje; kulula ukukuthola lapha kunanoma yikuphi.
settings.offer_body: Nikeza othile ukufinyelela mahhala ekubhaliseleni kwe-Mac. Amakhodi enziwa ku-App Store Connect futhi alayishwa ngokwehlukanisiwe; lokhu kunikeza lokho okuvele kukhona lapha. Ikhodi isetshenziswa ku-Mac yomamukeli, ngakho awudingi enye wena.
settings.offer_comp_done_off: Ilayisensi yabo izophela manje lapho i-Apple iyeka ukuyikhokhela. Noma yini i-Apple esele inikeziwe iyaqhubeka njengokuhleliwe.
settings.offer_comp_done_on: Ilayisensi yabo izoqhubeka isebenza ngemva kokuba i-Apple iyekile ukuyikhokhela. Akusekho okunye okumele bakufake.
settings.offer_comp_not_eligible: Lokhu kubhalisela kukhokhelwe, ngakho akukwazi ukunikezwa njenge-comp. Ukunikeza i-comp kuqondene kuphela nabantu abangene ngomnikelo we-comp.
settings.offer_confirm_void: Yeka ukunikeza {code}? Ngeke isanikwa noma ubani kusukela lapha. ISASEBENZA e-Apple, engenandlela yokuhoxisa ikhodi uma isivele yenziwe, ngakho noma ubani osevele enayo angasayisebenzisa.
settings.offer_empty: Awukho amakhodi lapha okwamanje. Yenza iqoqo ku-App Store Connect bese ulilayisha ngaphambi kokunikeza noma iyiphi.
settings.offer_people_body: Ubani osesebenzise ikhodi futhi osebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Mac. Ukunikeza umuntu i-comp kugcina ilayisensi yakhe isebenza ngemva kokuba isikhathi samahhala i-Apple esinikezile siphelile, ngakho abasoze basebenzise enye ikhodi futhi. Kuphela ukubhalisela okuqale ngomnikelo we-comp okungenikezwa i-comp; okukhokhelwe umuntu akusoze kwenzeka.
settings.offer_voided: {code} ngeke isanikezwa futhi. Noma ubani osevele enayo angasayisebenzisa.
settings.offer_who_required: Sho ukuthi le khodi iyokwabani. Ikhodi engabhaliswanga muntu ngeke ikwazi ukulandelelwa kamuva.
settings.report_body: I-Dawnlist isebenzisa i-AI eyakhayo ukuze ihlole izikhangiso zemisebenzi futhi ibhale imiyalezo yakho. Uma ikhiqiza okuthile okungafanele, okucasulayo, noma okungalungile ngokusobala, kubike futhi kuzofundwa.
settings.store_subscribe_detail: I-{title} — {price} ngenyanga. Iyaziphinda ngokuzenzakalela ngenani elifanayo uze ukhansele, okungenzeka nganoma isiphi isikhathi ku-Microsoft Store.
settings.store_subscribe_failed: I-Microsoft Store ayikwazanga ukuqedela lokho kuthenga. Akukho okukhokhiwe. Zama futhi ngokushesha.
settings.store_subscribe_loading: Iyabuza i-Microsoft Store ukuthi kubiza malini…
settings.store_subscribe_terms: Kukhokhiswa yi-Microsoft ngokusebenzisa i-Microsoft Store. Khansela nganoma isiphi isikhathi kusuka ku-Microsoft Store → Library → Subscriptions. Uzodinga isikhiye sakho se-Anthropic API: ukufunda izikhangiso nokubhala imilayezo kukhokhelwa ku-akhawunti yakho, hhayi eyethu.
settings.store_subscribe_unavailable: I-Microsoft Store ayitholakali okwamanje, ngakho ukubhalisela akukwazi ukuqalwa. Lokhu akudingani ne-akhawunti yakho — i-Dawnlist izozama futhi.
settings.store_subscribe_unavailable_mar: Lokhu kubhalisela akukathengiswa ezweni noma esifundeni sakho okwamanje.
settings.subscribe_body: Uphahla lomsebenzi lwe-Dawnlist luyi-subscription, ethengwa nge-App Store. Konke okuvele kukhona kule Mac kuhlala kuvuliwe noma yikuphi—ibhodi yakho, isifinyezo sakho kanye nomlandeli wakho abadingi i-subscription ukuze bafundwe.
settings.subscribe_deferred: Umthengo wakho ulinde ukuvunywa — isibonelo kumphathi womndeni, ngaphansi kuka-Ask to Buy. I-Dawnlist iyakuthola ngokwayo uma sekuvunyiwe, ngakho akudingeki uthenge futhi.
settings.subscribe_done: Ubhalisile. Ukudla kuyofundelwa wena kusukela kuhambo olulandelayo lwansuku zonke.
settings.subscribe_still_waiting: I-App Store ayikaphenduli. Uma kungabonakalanga iphepha lokuthenga, qinisekisa ukuthi ungenile ku-App Store — kolwakhiwo lokuhlola, ngaphansi kwe-System Settings, i-App Store, i-Sandbox Account. Ungazama futhi, ubuyisele ukuthenga kwangaphambilini, noma uqhubeke ubhalisele kamuva.
settings.subscribe_terms: {title} — {length}. Kuzovuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngentengo efanayo uze ukukhansele, okungenzeka noma nini ku-System Settings.
settings.subscribe_unavailable: I-App Store ayikwazi ukwamukela ukuthenga kule Mac okwamanje.
settings.title: Dawnlist — izilungiselelo
storekit.not_ready: Uxhumo lwe-App Store lusaqala. Zama futhi ngemva komzuzwana.
storekit.not_saved: Ukubhalisela kwakho kuqinisekisiwe, kodwa i-Keychain yale Mac ayikwazanga ukukusindisa. I-Dawnlist izophinde izame ngesikhathi elandelayo ivulwa — ngeke ukhokhiswe kabili.
storekit.unconfirmed: I-App Store inomthengo, kodwa i-Dawnlist ayikakwazi ukuwuqinisekisa nesevisi yokubhalisela okwamanje. Izophinde izame ngokwayo ngesikhathi i-Dawnlist ivulwa futhi — ngeke ukhokhiswe kabili.
tray.still_running: I-Dawnlist isasebenza, ngakho uhambo lwakho lwansuku zonke lwenzeka ngesikhathi. Vula noma uphume kuleli phawu.
update.body: Le khophi ivela ewebhusayithi, ngakho-ke izibuyekezo zifika nazo lapho. Ikhasi lokulanda linenguqulo entsha, esayiniwe, ne-checksum yayo ishicilelwe eceleni kwayo. Akukho lutho kule mishini oluguqukayo uze ulifake ngokwakho.
update.title: Isibuyekezo siyatholakala
voice.no_profile: Asikho isimo somoya okwamanje — engeza eminye imiyalezo yakho owayithumela
voice.profile_from: Isimo somoya sifundwe kusukela kwimiyalezo {count} owayithumela wena ngokwakho
